assets.prompt: ONE isolated military transport TRUCK cutout, true alpha-transparent background, for a HOI4 national focus called Swift Columns in a post-apocalyptic Khan army. Rugged functional mid-century 6x6 cargo truck with a long hood, simple angular cab, flat divided windshield, broad vertical radiator grille, two round headlamps, three axles, six large offroad tyres, canvas-covered cargo bed on ribs. Light practical bolted steel protection around cab lower doors and front bumper, not a fantasy armored monster. Worn dark charcoal-olive paint, faded dark burgundy small plain identification strip on cab door, no symbol or writing; khaki-olive canvas taut over load. Three-quarter FRONT LEFT viewpoint, truck moving toward lower LEFT, side recedes upper right. Low camera so wheels and grille make a strong aggressive silhouette. Front wheels slightly steered, believable stance, sharp cab silhouette and tyre tread, metal rough and weathered. Hard photographic cutout montage style with coarse print grain, deep black shadows, strong warm ivory edge highlights and amber light on upper surfaces. High contrast, gritty processed war-poster finish rather than polished showroom rendering or cartoon. Entire truck including all wheels, rear bed and bumper visible inside 10 percent transparent margins. ONE truck only, no other vehicles or loose accessories, no visible driver, people, weapon turret, flags, numbers, letters, map, ground, road, dust, smoke, glow, scenery, shadow outside vehicle or frame. Keep spaces beneath chassis and around wheels transparent. Wide landscape composition, broad readable shapes suitable for a very small focus icon.

ONE isolated dynamic ROAD DUST and TYRE TRACK supporting layer for a military Swift Columns focus collage, true transparent background. A narrow broken fragment of dark dry road runs diagonally from broad lower-left foreground toward upper-right distance; two bold parallel tyre tracks mark its surface. Dense ochre and dark olive dust kicked up along the right edge streams backward toward upper-right in jagged long diagonal streaks. Keep left and upper-middle largely open transparent space for separate trucks. Low dust trail, not a tall explosion cloud; no fire, smoke column or sparks. Stylized harsh photographic montage cutout, coarse print grain, deep charcoal road and shadows, warm dirty gold rim on thick dust, ragged torn alpha edges, sharp directional streaks to communicate rapid forward movement. Compact broad landscape 4:3 fragment, no rectangular full landscape, sky or horizon and no miniature terrain slab. All dust trails end within generous 8 percent transparent outer margin. Absolutely NO vehicle, wheel, people, aircraft, text, arrow, flag, medal, frame, badge or solid background. This is one cohesive compositing layer, road and dust ONLY.

EDIT image1, the exact supplied cutout military cargo truck. Add a forceful TFR-style graphic MOTION TAIL behind it. Image2 is STYLE ONLY for distressed directional light streaks and kinetic graphic texture, do not copy its text, aircraft, map or symbols. Preserve truck design, pose, perspective, weathered olive/ochre colors, cab, grille, wheels, canvas and small plain burgundy door stripe as closely as possible. Keep the truck itself crisp, no blurring across front cab, headlights or front wheels. Truck drives toward LOWER LEFT. Trail must extend BEHIND its rear to RIGHT and slightly UPWARD. Expand transparent canvas to the right enough to contain entire effect, retaining full bumper and tyres. Add 3-5 layered offset semi-transparent charcoal and amber echoes of the rear body silhouette, quickly dissolving into LONG parallel ragged streaks, dirty ochre-gold streaks with a few warm ivory bright cores, granular disintegration and sparse little angular flecks. Streaks follow the receding truck side perspective. Strong near the rear chassis and canvas edge, taper to transparent at far right. Small low road-dust spurt behind rear tyres joins tail, but no road or terrain. This is a graphic directional motion smear / afterimage with coarse poster grain, not flames, explosion, smoke wall, electric lightning or a full halo. Effect around rear only; main foreground silhouette stays legible. No extra vehicles, people, text, numbers, flag, badge, frame, background rectangle or surrounding landscape. Entire truck and tail within 6 percent transparent margin, wide landscape framing. TRUE alpha transparency around truck, beneath chassis and in all gaps; preserve input transparency. Final deliverable is this same truck WITH the motion effect.
